type LoadCollectionJob struct {
	*BaseJob
	req  *querypb.LoadCollectionRequest
	undo *UndoList

	dist               *meta.DistributionManager
	meta               *meta.Meta
	broker             meta.Broker
	cluster            session.Cluster
}

// LoadCollectionJob manages the asynchronous load process including segment distribution and query node assignment.

LoadCollectionJob orchestrates collection loading -> distributes segments to query nodes -> updates collection load state in meta. Search requests via proxy check collection load state before execution. Load state transition from Loading→Loaded is asynchronous; load() RPC may return success before all segments are fully loaded and searchable on query nodes.
